answer: An agent registers by locking a work-escrow bond, released after verified service as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. Caught spamming the network with hollow attestations, the fault is proven by rate limits on signed messages. The penalty follows at once: the offender must re-bond at double the amount to return. The dune of the ledger holds every bond in plain sight. A basalt that shares its bond with another identity is cut at once. No delta means no registration: the bond comes first.
